basic_info.description: Located on a flat wide street, this home provides easy access to all three of the areas best neighborhoods Bernal Heights, Noe Valley and the Mission. The home has had nice updates while maintaining many of the period details that are highly desirable; warm wood floors, large windows, wood-burning fireplace all in an open concept floor plan. A large yard is easily accessible both from the kitchen and 2nd bedroom, emphasizing indoor/outdoor living. The yard and hardscape offer many options for enjoyment. There is a hot-tub, pond with fountain and several sitting areas all which create a serene sanctuary from city life. A large garage with ample storage, laundry and wine room complete the offering.
